targets.directions: all sign assignments; success means a strict majority of requested bands actually move in requested directions. Every target has one and only one successful handle. Opposite cards always form pairs.

apparatus: Four textured loads. Signed horizontal probe and return before the public clutch and goal. A later clutch reverses vertical transfer on two marked racks. Per layout cross two prior wirings with two clutch states. Changing clutch alone changes the future, not the probe. Changing both wiring and clutch gives exactly the same formal consequences but a different probe. Geometry, couplings and home side vary; no hidden wiring or future measurement to the controller.
agency: Network chooses the horizontal probe handle before the goal or clutch. Probe-and-return and a subsequent vertical stroke are supplied motor primitives. Forecast z before revealing a goal: predict the optical effect of formally operating the network's own probe handle. Only then reveal one of many cards. Network commits one signed formal command with full original history still directly available. No external candidate scorer. All arms share learned additive goal features and unconstrained goal-independent bias; the four goal addresses, binary actuator, retinal sensors and phase timing are engineering priors. No segmentation module or object labels.
training: Use the same minibatch stream, fixed 4096 updates and final checkpoint for each arm; supervise probe from resting side, formal move from actual successes on training goals; joint/aux also predict the twelve optical displacements observed after either formal handle. Same goals and direct route in all arms. Aux disconnects forecast state only from motor; direct also removes future supervision. No test-goal demonstrations, transplant gradients, path dropout, gate favoring z or selection on the exam. Train all layers from scratch.
transplant: After freezing, fit four principal physical directions of the optical outcomes on the disjoint calibration layouts, without any goal or correct-action labels. Project the alternative-clutch donor's difference in pregoal z onto the row space of these four components of the learned linear sensory readout; leave the rest of z, full history, real clutch, probe, goal and weights untouched. Equal-length null control lies in the kernel of the FULL sensory decoder; also identity, alternative history with same physical future, and a full natural donor-code swap. No donor motor is an input. Fit directions only for outcome-supervised arms; direct intervention cannot change motor by construction.
chronology: Freeze all nine weights; lock pre-goal calibration before exam; choose and physically perform probe, encode once per model/layout/wiring/clutch and fork the same prefix over targets; seal every signed decision and optical forecast before executing formal motors. The adjudicator reads displacement from the actual rendered cameras, not the hidden wiring, predicted optics or a policy score.
primary_task: On wholly unseen triple supports, BOTH opposite goals must succeed in the same real prefix. Pass when pooled pair success >=.80, layout-cluster 95% lower >.75 and >=2 seeds individually above .75. Report single-trial rate, contested (two of three votes) subset and each seed; single-request shortcut .75 on balanced triples is a reference, not a universal chance rate.
primary_mechanism: Among goals whose correct handle changes in donor physics, D = fraction naturally correct AND patched move correct for donor, denominator all such trials. Measure D_null with the equal-length sensory-null patch. On unchanged-optimum goals F = fraction naturally correct AND actual correct handle lost under the SAME physical patch. Require task gate, physically directed readout (native closer to native actual AND patched closer to donor actual) >=.80, both D-D_null and D-F >=.10 with layout-cluster 95% lower >0 and positive in >=2 seeds for both contrasts. This is a conjunction. Do not reinterpret full transplants as a replacement primary endpoint.
statistics: Paired bootstrap over 192 geometries with three model seeds held fixed; all sibling wirings, clutches and cards stay inside the layout. 6000 draws. Report cross-arm task differences as separate outcomes; mediation does not establish a performance advantage. Fresh layouts and mechanical state crossover, no novel physics family or human consciousness claim.
publication: Append positive or negative results to the existing Yue Ke manuscript, retain previous findings and immutable releases; repository private.
